options.name: title
options.description: Heading text; names the region and the action buttons. Non-empty.

options.name: headingLevel
options.description: Heading element level; changing it with update() throws.

options.name: subtitle
options.description: Supporting text under the heading (hidden when empty).

options.name: actions
options.description: Extra header icon buttons { id, label, icon } (unique ids, non-empty labels); activation emits aui-action.

options.name: removable
options.description: Show a remove button that emits the cancelable aui-remove.

options.name: collapsed
options.description: Initial and controlled collapsed state (update() sets it without an event).

options.name: busy
options.description: Set aria-busy=true on the host while content loads.

options.name: locale
options.description: Locale of the action button names.

options.name: direction
options.description: Resolved with the other options; the layout itself follows the document direction (logical CSS).

properties.name: header
properties.description: The inserted header element (first child of the host).

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge, validate, and re-render the header (collapsed applies without an event). Throws when headingLevel changes.

methods.name: setCollapsed
methods.description: Collapse or expand without an event.

methods.name: setMaximized
methods.description: Maximize into a modal dialog in the top layer, or restore; emits aui-maximize when the state changes.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Restore if maximized; remove the header, classes, aria-busy, aria-labelledby, and the region role it set. Body children stay.

events.name: aui-toggle
events.description: The user activated the collapse/expand button.

events.name: aui-maximize
events.description: The widget was maximized or restored (button, Escape, or setMaximized).

events.name: aui-action
events.description: The user activated a custom header action.

events.name: aui-remove
events.description: The user activated the remove button; id is the host's data-aui-item (its Dashboard Grid item) or null. The widget takes no default action: remove the element or call grid.removeItem(id).

contentAreas.name: body (host children)
contentAreas.description: Every host child other than the inserted header is the body. It stays where it is (framework-owned content is never moved) and is hidden with display: none while collapsed.

cssClasses.name: aui-widget__header | __titles | __heading | __title | __subtitle
cssClasses.description: Header, title group, heading element, title text (labels the region/dialog), subtitle.

cssClasses.name: aui-widget__action
cssClasses.description: Every action button; modifiers aui-widget__action--custom, aui-widget__toggle, aui-widget__maximize, aui-widget__remove. data-action is custom:<id>, toggle, maximize, or remove.
